title: Daily AI Brief — Improvement Kanban
purpose: Persistent system-improvement, technical-debt, validation and UX backlog. Separate from per-edition Tasks 00–29 execution Kanban.

rules: Do not reopen items whose authoritative learning record is permanently_fixed unless new evidence demonstrates regression.
Superseded historical instructions remain evidence, not current instructions.
New cards require a source reference and explicit acceptance criteria.
Lane moves are user/operator decisions; automated reconciliation annotates evidence but never silently moves a card.
Per-edition Tasks 00–29 remain on the production Kanban, not this board.
Production instructions must be generic and must not contain a named historical run.

cards.title: Generalize terminal-run protection
cards.summary: Replace the transitional historical-run-specific guard with a generic rule: every prior PUBLIC_CLOSED / terminal run is immutable and recovery follows only the active nonterminal execution.
acceptance: No persistent recovery/controller guard hard-codes the prior production baseline after the completed stability window.
Regression coverage proves multiple closed prior runs are never reopened.

cards.title: Validate production Task 21 repair path
cards.summary: The rehearsal exercised a focused-repair path not used by prior production executions. Prove a production-style repair request has an executor before changing production behavior.
acceptance: Production-style repair request has a bound executor.
Same execution resumes without reopening completed tasks.
No production change unless production evidence justifies it.

cards.title: Keep rehearsal completeness regression isolated
cards.summary: Retain the rehearsal landing-page completeness test and correction without importing the rehearsal assembler into normal production.
acceptance: PR #387 dispositioned after the completed stability window stability window.
Rehearsal pages cannot silently drop images, book bridges, media navigation or Watchlist detail.

cards.title: Prove real Task 11–16 handoff resumes Supervisor
cards.summary: Synthetic handoff passed. Confirm a real production image-worker release dispatches the same production execution and advances the first incomplete dependent task.
acceptance: Real release triggers same-execution Supervisor.
No duplicate execution and no completed-task rework.

cards.title: Prove recoverable rejection is recognized automatically
cards.summary: Schema normalization is implemented; validate on a real recoverable image rejection that the Supervisor dispatches the bounded next action without owner intervention.
acceptance: Equivalent blocker shapes normalize safely.
Real recoverable rejection advances automatically.

cards.title: Exercise merge-time authorization guards
cards.summary: Run READY/authorized and blocked fixtures against both autonomous publication paths so host/run authorization changes after candidate CI fail closed.
acceptance: Authorized fixture may promote.
Blocked/stale authorization fixture cannot merge.
Closure stays bound to the validated publication event.

cards.title: Exercise PNG chunk bridge on first real need
cards.summary: The protected fallback is implemented but should be exercised only when a visually valid candidate cannot use direct complete-Base64 create_blob delivery.
acceptance: Exact bytes reconstructed and Git-read-back verified.
Saved-Git visual review still precedes acceptance.

cards.title: Track image duration, attempts and safe simplification
cards.summary: Measure every image wall time and attempts-to-accept. If duration rises, simplify non-value-add process before adding machinery while preserving the the prior production baseline quality standard.
acceptance: Per-image duration and attempts visible in run evidence.
Trend compared with prior runs.
Simplification preserves professional image gates.
sources: owner the prior production baseline image feedback

cards.title: Complete 14-edition Watchlist rubric review
cards.summary: Review the provisional Watchlist rubric after the documented 14-edition assessment; do not automatically enable weighting changes.
acceptance: Detection lead time, source diversity, archival/false-positive rate and missed concepts reviewed.
Any rubric change separately approved.

cards.title: Reconcile stale Work/Codex language in Watchlist runbook
cards.summary: The Watchlist runbook still contains historical Work/Codex allowance language that conflicts with the current zero-Work production policy.
acceptance: Current no-Work/no-paid-service policy is unambiguous.
Historical guidance is clearly marked superseded rather than silently deleted.

cards.title: Reduce conflicting historical operating instructions
cards.summary: Living documentation contains superseded paths. Add explicit current/superseded boundaries so startup logic cannot follow stale operational advice.
acceptance: Current path is discoverable from START-HERE.
Superseded sections remain historical evidence but cannot be mistaken for current policy.

cards.title: Evaluate outer recovery latency SLO
cards.summary: Hourly Recovery at :48 is a second-level backstop. Verify Supervisor + event-driven handoff + watchdog make the near-60-minute worst-case backstop acceptable before changing cadence.
acceptance: Observed primary recovery latency measured.
No schedule change unless evidence shows an actual liveness gap.

cards.title: Design authenticated HTML5 write-back
cards.summary: Initial HTML5 board uses localStorage and JSON import/export. Design a safe repository write-back path without embedding credentials in the page.
acceptance: No browser token embedded or stored in source.
Approved changes can be committed through an authenticated external workflow.

cards.title: Automate Kanban reconciliation from living evidence
cards.summary: Build a reconciler that ingests the improvement ledger and designated living docs, removes fixed/superseded work, and proposes new cards without reviving closed incidents.
acceptance: Deterministic dedupe/supersession rules.
Every generated card retains source references.
Human-approved lane moves remain authoritative.

cards.title: Resolve production Command Center sync pending state
cards.summary: Current publication status marks Command Center synchronization pending even though the public edition is completed.
acceptance: Canonical status and Command Center agree or pending state is explicitly retired if no longer required.

cards.title: Reconcile four-book reader expectation with relevance-first contract
cards.summary: Current book-selection documentation has no balance quota, while the reader expectation is that all four Professional Series books should appear across a daily slate when support exists.
acceptance: Policy states when four-book distribution is expected versus when relevance overrides distribution.
No forced low-relevance book mapping.

cards.title: Maintain restricted-source assisted-review coverage
cards.summary: Keep X, Discord and other restricted/identity-sensitive sources classified as assisted review rather than automated failure, with current evidence and explicit deferral.
acceptance: Required source surfaces show complete/degraded/assisted status honestly.
No empty/login page counts as reviewed.

cards.title: Standardize improvement-board PNG rendering
cards.summary: Keep the approved navy dashboard style, Backlog → WIP → Done order, readable task cards, and bottom readiness/repository/controller/risk/next-action panels.
acceptance: Same JSON produces repeatable board layout.
No clipped/overlapping text.
Current Risk and Next Action always present.

cards.title: Create canonical Improvement Kanban system
cards.summary: Create the machine-readable board, capture/update rules, HTML5 visual interface and reproducible PNG view.
acceptance: Canonical JSON exists.
HTML5 add/edit/drag/drop/import/export works.
PNG generated from the same canonical data.
Repository PR opened without changing production behavior.

cards.title: Disposition rehearsal reader correction PR #387
cards.summary: Exact-head CI is green; keep the correction isolated and avoid unnecessary prior non-production production changes.
acceptance: Merge/close decision after production stability window.
No production renderer/controller changes introduced.

cards.title: Remove expired rehearsal overlay from Recovery
cards.summary: Daily Brief Recovery now contains production-only image-consumer instructions; hourly :48 schedule and 01:00 Controller were preserved.
acceptance: Verified automation state after update.

cards.title: Deterministic Task 17 repository consumer
cards.summary: Dedicated Task 17 consumer exists and succeeded in the prior production baseline and the rehearsal.
acceptance: Task 17 request consumed from authoritative image evidence.

cards.title: Normalize recoverable-blocker schema drift
cards.summary: Safe alias normalization prevents semantically equivalent recovery evidence from stranding supervision while ambiguous/external blockers remain fail-closed.
acceptance: Regression coverage present.

cards.title: Refresh writer authority at scheduled worker invocation
cards.summary: Embedded writer generation is provenance only; scheduled workers acquire fresh same-execution fenced authority and explicitly release at durable boundaries.
acceptance: Stale generation cannot mutate run.

cards.title: Event-driven Supervisor handoff synthetic proof
cards.summary: Bounded non-production rehearsal proved explicit worker release can resume the same Supervisor execution with no rework.
acceptance: Synthetic handoff PASS.

cards.title: Add merge-time host/run authorization guard
cards.summary: Autonomous promotion now re-reads protected host readiness and same-run authorization immediately before merge.
acceptance: Permanent guard implemented and live validation passed.

cards.title: Validate professional image quality pattern
cards.summary: the prior production baseline completed six accepted_locked images with targeted retries, pretransport review, exact Git read-back and saved-Git review; owner assessed the set as very good.
acceptance: Six accepted images and positive owner quality validation.

cards.title: Pre-next-run production authorization PASS
cards.summary: Protected receipt authorizes the next production run with image and publication authorization true while preserving the prior production baseline.
acceptance: next_production_run_authorized=true on protected main.

cards.title: Start each edition the prior evening
cards.summary: The production controller is scheduled for 19:00 America/Chicago and targets the next local calendar day, increasing the overnight recovery window.
acceptance: Controller schedule is 19:00 America/Chicago daily.
At 19:00 the target edition date is the next local calendar day.
Existing active nonterminal execution is resumed before any allocation.

cards.title: Require article reading times and podcast runtimes
cards.summary: Reader-time metadata is now a publication requirement for new editions.
acceptance: Every article has verified source reading time.
Every published podcast has verified positive runtime.
Edition overview renders both.

reconciliation_contract.rule: Annotate cards from latest learning status and surface every unresolved ledger problem not represented on the board. Never silently move lanes.
